name: UK energy price cap
summary: Cap £1,723 a year; Cornwall Insight forecasts £1,999 for January, a 16% rise; Ofgem's January cap is due late November
state: Ofgem's cap for October to December 2026 is £1,723 a year for a typical dual-fuel household (Cornwall Insight). Cornwall Insight's forecast for January to March 2027, calculated from prices on 28 Sep, is £1,999.28, about 16% higher and inside the 5–20% Watch band. No newer Cornwall Insight forecast was found as of 12 Nov; Ofgem is due to announce the January cap in late November.
for_you: Households on standard variable tariffs are exposed to a higher cap from 1 Jan. Ofgem publishes the cap and guidance on help with bills; Citizens Advice covers support for those struggling to pay.
rubric_hit: Watch: cap £1,723 within £1,700–2,200, forecast rise ~16% (≥5%, below 20% Alert line)

sources.title: Cornwall Insight — Default tariff cap predictions and insights

why: The Ofgem cap sets bills for most UK households — a direct cost-of-living signal.
drivers: Wholesale gas and power prices, network costs, policy levies.

rubric.normal: Typical dual-fuel cap < £1,700/yr and next forecast change < +5%.
